item.description: Casa Dos Playas sits in Nosara, Costa Rica, by Salagnac Arquitectos, a 2025 house shaped by earthen brick walls, wood structure, and coastal climate sensibilities.

item.title: Rooh: Wabi-Sabi Holiday Home | HomeAdore
item.description: Rooh anchors a holiday house in Malpe, India, by Thomas Parambil Architects, between river and Arabian Sea. The low-slung retreat turns away from the obvious postcard view to follow an east-west axis, wrapping daily life around a pool and long deck. Here, shared rooms merge in one open volume while bedroom suites pull back into quieter territory, giving family and friends a place to gather without losing a sense of retreat.
